# Off Road Connection Parts
> India's Leading Specialist for Luxury & 4x4 Automotive Spare Parts

## Overview
Off Road Connection Parts provides 100% genuine OEM-grade automotive replacement parts, performance upgrades, and accessories for luxury European and premium Japanese/American brands in India.

- **Headquarters**: Plot 2, Opp Asgarpur park, kharsa Number 307 Asgarpur jaagir sector 128, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201301, India
- **Hotline / WhatsApp**: +91 88607 18878
- **Website**: https://offroadconnection.pages.dev
- **Delivery Coverage**: All 19,000+ Indian pincodes with express courier dispatch (2-5 business days)

## Supported Vehicle Makes & Fitment Coverage
- **Audi**: A3, A4, A6, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, RS Series
- **BMW**: 3 Series (E90, F30, G20), 5 Series (E60, F10, G30), 7 Series, X1, X3, X5, X6, X7
- **Mercedes-Benz**: C-Class (W204, W205, W206), E-Class (W212, W213), S-Class, CLA, GLA, GLC, GLE (W166), GLS, G-Wagon
- **Porsche**: Macan (95B), Cayenne (92A, 9YA), Panamera, 911 Carrera
- **Range Rover & Land Rover**: Vogue (L405), Sport (L494), Evoque, Velar, Defender (L663), Discovery
- **Jaguar**: XE, XF, XJ / XJL, F-Pace
- **Volvo**: S60, S90, XC40, XC60, XC90
- **Jeep**: Wrangler Rubicon / Sahara, Compass, Grand Cherokee
- **Toyota**: Fortuner (Type 1, Type 2, Legender), Hilux, Land Cruiser LC200 / LC300, Prado
- **Mahindra & Isuzu**: Thar (CRDe, 2020+, Roxx), Scorpio-N, XUV700, D-Max V-Cross

## Core Part Categories
1. **Lighting & Headlamps**: LED Matrix headlights, Xenon projectors, tail lights, ballast control modules.
2. **Suspension & Steering**: Air suspension struts, control arms, ball joints, hydraulic shock absorbers.
3. **Cooling & AC Systems**: AC compressors, radiators, intercoolers, transmission oil coolers, water pumps.
4. **Brake Systems**: Ceramic brake pads, ventilated brake rotors, ABS wheel speed sensors, brake calipers.
5. **Engine & Transmission**: Engine mounts, timing chain kits, spark plugs, filters, gaskets.
6. **Body Parts & Grilles**: Panamericana grilles, M-Sport bumpers, fenders, bonnets, side mirrors.
7. **4x4 Off-Road Equipment**: Heavy-duty electric winches, recovery gear, snorkels, bash plates.

## Ordering & Customer Guarantees
- 100% Fitment Verification by VIN / Chassis Number before shipping.
- Safe Payments via Razorpay (UPI, Credit/Debit Cards, Net Banking) and COD on select items.
- Nationwide warranty and dedicated automotive technical support desk.
